pois.name: Richard Serra's Carnegie

prompt.text: Find the tall rusty steel tower in front of the art museum. Is it one piece of metal, or several?

reveal.text: Four steel plates, leaning on each other.

story.text: This is Carnegie by Richard Serra. It's about 40 feet tall and went up for the 1985 Carnegie International, where it tied for first prize.
Only one mill, Lukens Steel in Coatesville, Pennsylvania, could roll plates this big. They were put together on Neville Island, in the Ohio River.
The rust is on purpose. This kind of steel forms its own protective coating, so it never needs paint.
